# PROVENANCE: captured live. `docket serve --port 18337` against the
# pre-existing default DOCKET_HOME (~/.docket) — see the caveat in
# `health.json`'s header; NOT an isolated sandbox. The
# `docket_approvals_total{channel="timeout",outcome="denied"} 11` line below
# is that real installation's genuine audit history — including, per the
# same caveat, 11 denials this very capture run's own startup sweep caused
# by fail-closed-expiring already-stale pending approvals. Left as captured,
# unedited, because it is an accurate real Prometheus payload and a useful
# non-zero-counter fixture; response body of
# `curl http://127.0.0.1:18337/metrics`, 2026-08-04. Unauthenticated route,
# Prometheus text-exposition format.

# TYPE docket_tool_calls_total counter

# TYPE docket_policy_hits_total counter
